title: Set up dtk
subtitle: Four steps, then the console is yours.

tokenBanner.title: Setup token required
tokenBanner.description: The token was printed to the container log. Run docker compose logs api and paste it here.
tokenBanner.label: Setup token
tokenBanner.hint: The token expires 24 hours after the api container starts.

admin.title: Create an administrator
admin.description: This account can do everything, including changing sensitive settings.

proxy.title: Add a proxy
proxy.description: Optional. Without one, every identity shares the server egress address.

mint.title: Mint the first identity
mint.description: Identities carry the fingerprint and cookies used for upstream requests.
mint.unavailable: This instance has no browser container, so it cannot mint identities. That is a supported way to run it - import a cookie jar instead - or start the browser and come back.

smoke.title: Smoke test
smoke.description: Parse one real public link end to end, so you know it works before you rely on it.

admin.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. There is no password reset by email; recovery is a CLI command.
admin.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

proxy.label: Proxy list
proxy.formats: Accepted formats: host:port, host:port:user:pass, user:pass@host:port, scheme://user:pass@host:port

mint.running: Minting. This takes a few seconds.
mint.unavailableHint: Run that beside your other containers, set DTK_BROWSER_RPC_URL=http://browser-rpc:9000 in .env, and restart. Without it, add identities from the Identities page by pasting the cookies from a browser you are already signed in to.

smoke.urlHint: Any public video link on a supported platform.
smoke.failed: The smoke test failed. The diagnose page explains which step broke.

alreadyInitialized.title: Already initialized
alreadyInitialized.description: This instance already has an administrator.
